## Wave 1 Summary

This wave lands the S101 W-2 workshop's rank-1 theorem into the permanent record and arms its two pre-registered falsifiers. The workshop (volovik × phonon-first; CONVERGED 3 rounds, 2026-06-09) re-scoped the capstone §6.3 substrate→FRW `a(t)`-gap from "unfinished algebra" to a **single rank-1 normalization non-universality**: the substrate spectral triple `(A_K, H_K, D_K)` determines the entire dimensionless dynamical content of the cosmology (conformal class, ratios, tilts, growth shapes, the n=2 late-time tracking exponent) from zero continuous parameters, and imports exactly ONE externally-calibrated dimensional scale, the cutoff `M_KK`. The obstruction is `O = w·Ô` with `w = M_KK`, the K=3-MANDATORY multiplicative-normalization cancellation invariant (FRW = a fourth structurally-distinct instance), and its topological cause is `N₃ = 0` (BDI class, S44 — the induced metric carries no Fermi-point protection). Five items: (1) Stage-1 registration of the frozen Stage-0 theorem-tag (clauses (a)–(g), JOINT = (a)/(c)/(e)); (2) FALSIFIER (i) / CF-α — the R1 source-check (can `gamma_unit = Φ(D_K alone)` be written with zero imported scale?); (3) FALSIFIER (ii) / CF-β — the rank-1 covariance count-check across all dagger-rows; (4) the Stage-2 two-agent cross-axis verify of the Stage-1 entry; (5) the capstone §6.3 designated-writer re-scope patch. The two falsifiers are pre-registered SYMMETRICALLY: each carries an explicit theorem-CONFIRMING branch and an explicit theorem-FALSIFYING branch, so neither is an iterate-until-PASS dispatch (per `v3-closure-recovery.md` PROHIBITED_ACTIONS Class 6).

**Substrate framing (load-bearing for the whole wave)**: the explanation direction is unchanged — `D_K eigenvalues → spectral moments → dimensionless dynamical shapes (n=2 tracking, tilts, growth, conformal class) → measurement`. The re-scope is a POSITIVE finding about what the substrate DETERMINES, not a deficit confession. Only the terminal `× (ℏ / M_KK c²)` second is the external multiplier where the eigenvalue problem is silent BY CONSTRUCTION (`N₃ = 0`). This wave is mostly GEOMETRIC (the fabric's spectral-triple structure and its emergent-metric normalization), with one PHONONIC leg (the relic-clock pole rider) and one NON-PHONONIC methodology leg (the capstone prose patch).

```yaml
# ---- Identity (6 fields) ----
gate_id: "S102-NNU-FALSIFIER-I-R1-SOURCECHECK"
schema_version: "R3"
trigger: "[CHAIN]"                 # the gate IS the substitution-chain test of whether seconds reachable from dimensionless spectral data
classification: "GEOMETRIC"        # emergent-metric normalization / the substrate->seconds conversion gamma_unit; the fabric's dimensional readout
agent_type: "volovik-superfluid-universe-theorist"   # Sakharov-non-universality / induced-gravity dimensional bookkeeping is volovik's substrate domain (he authored V1 dimensional chain); CF-α is a SUBSTRATE compute (NOT a Stage-2 verify, so the Stage-0-author exclusion does NOT apply — that exclusion governs items 4's reviewers only)
hypothesis: "gamma_unit = dt_SI/dt_sub (the substrate->seconds conversion H(tau_now) in km/s/Mpc needs) CANNOT be written as Phi(D_K eigenvalues alone, f, Lambda) without importing a dimensionful GeV/seconds scale; therefore an honest H(tau_now) compute from D_K+f+Lambda alone either FAILs the zero-new-parameter clause (it secretly imports M_KK-in-GeV) -> theorem CONFIRMED rank-1, or PASSes within a factor of 2 of 67.4 km/s/Mpc with zero new continuous parameters AND derived kappa == kappa_nat -> theorem FALSIFIED rank-0."

method:
  description: >
    Two-branch SYMMETRIC falsifier (NO iterate-until-PASS). Build H(tau_now) from the substrate
    inputs ONLY: the L_max=12 D_K spectrum cache (eigenvalues, dimensionless / in M_KK units),
    the gauge connection f, the spectral cutoff Lambda = M_KK, the moduli kinetic coefficient
    G_DeWitt=5.0 (S42), the §8.3 dictionary f2 ~ 92 = M_Pl/M_KK. Attempt to assemble a quantity
    with units of inverse-time (km/s/Mpc) from these alone. STATICALLY enumerate every dimensionful
    factor entering the assembled H(tau_now); flag any factor that is M_KK-in-GeV or hbar-in-(J*s)
    (an imported scale). Compute the derived kappa = hbar/(M_KK_GeV * GeV_to_J) and compare to the
    S96 canonical kappa_nat. PASS-branch (theorem-FALSIFYING): H(tau_now) within factor 2 of 67.4
    km/s/Mpc with ZERO imported continuous parameter AND |derived_kappa - kappa_nat|/kappa_nat <= 1e-3.
    FAIL-branch (theorem-CONFIRMING): the assembly imports M_KK-in-GeV (the zero-new-parameter clause
    fails); the factor-2 hit, if it occurs, is achieved ONLY because M_KK was externally calibrated
    to M_Pl/M_KK ~ f2 ~ 92 (the §8.3 dictionary), i.e., the import does all the work. Both branches
    pre-registered; the verdict is whichever the static-enumeration + numerical test returns.
  producing_script: "computations/_shared/s102_nnu_falsifier_i_r1_sourcecheck.py"

# ---- PRDR Checklist (8 items) ----

# (1) operator — two-branch falsifier (NON-numerical adjudication w/ a numerical sub-test)
operator:
  type: "set"        # branch-selection: {imported-scale-present} vs {zero-import-and-band-hit}
  form: "FAIL (theorem CONFIRMED) iff (M_KK-in-GeV OR hbar-in-Js) in dimensionful_factors(H_assembled)  ;  PASS (theorem FALSIFIED) iff dimensionful_factors(H_assembled) contains NO imported scale AND |H_assembled - 67.4|/67.4 <= 1.0 (factor of 2 band) AND |derived_kappa - kappa_nat|/kappa_nat <= 1e-3"

# (2) strict_PASS_boundary
strict_PASS_boundary:
  value: "factor-of-2 band: 33.7 <= H_assembled(km/s/Mpc) <= 134.8  (i.e. 67.4/2 .. 67.4*2)  AND  |derived_kappa - kappa_nat|/kappa_nat <= 1e-3  AND  imported_scale_count == 0"
  direction: "<="    # all three conjuncts must hold for the (theorem-falsifying) PASS branch

# (3) boundary_reachable_analytically
boundary_reachable_analytically:
  bool: true
  proof_ref: "The factor-2 band edges 33.7 / 134.8 are analytically 67.4/2 and 67.4*2 (the workshop CF-α pre-registration). The dimensional-unreachability claim is analytically derived in the substitution chain below (the codomain 'seconds' is not reachable from a dimensionless domain) -- this is the FAIL-branch certificate; the PASS branch requires the analytic claim to be WRONG, which is the falsification."

# (4) reachable_rationals
reachable_rationals:
  includes_integer_mesh: false
  mesh_density: "continuous (H_assembled is a real value in km/s/Mpc); the gate is the import-presence test, not a rational-mesh search"

# (5) machinery_pin_map
machinery_pin_map:
  N_eval: "1 (single assembly of H(tau_now); no scan)"
  L_max: "12"        # the s84 master cache truncation; Friedrich-Bar-saturated for the bottom-spectrum moments (the dimensional argument is L-independent, but the cache is the substrate input)
  scan_range: "N/A — single-point evaluation at tau_now"
  step_size: "N/A"
  tolerance: "factor-2 band on H (analytic edges); 1e-3 RATIO on derived_kappa vs kappa_nat"
  scheme: "SI-dimensional-chain-hbar-over-E"    # matches S96-W1-MKK-SECONDS scheme exactly
  convention: "natural-units-to-SI-M_KK-SYMMETRIC-FALSIFIER"
  random_seed: "N/A — deterministic"
  GPU_path: "numpy.linalg (cache is pre-diagonalized; only moment sums + dimensional bookkeeping; <100x100 working arrays -> cpu-cap-OMP8: os.environ.setdefault('OMP_NUM_THREADS','8') BEFORE import numpy)"
  dimensionful_factor_enumeration: "STATIC AST + symbolic-units pass over the H-assembly expression; each multiplicative factor tagged {dimensionless-spectral | M_KK-in-GeV-IMPORT | hbar-in-Js-IMPORT | G_DeWitt-pure-number | f2-dimensionless-ratio}; imported_scale_count = count of *-IMPORT tags"
  kappa_nat_value: "8.860439881925477e-42  # M_KK_inv_seconds, S96-W1-MKK-SECONDS canonical; the derived-kappa cross-check target"

# (6) audit_discriminators
audit_discriminators:
  audit_sha256_inputs: ["script", "s84_cache_sha", "kappa_nat_canonical", "M_KK_canonical", "pinmap"]
  content_sha256_inputs: ["script"]

# (7) substitution_chain — MANDATORY (the "factor of 2 of 67.4" + the dimensional-unreachability claim)
substitution_chain:
  required: true
  content: |
    Claim: "H(tau_now) assembled from D_K + f + Lambda alone CANNOT land within a factor of 2 of
            67.4 km/s/Mpc with zero imported continuous parameter -- the seconds it needs are not
            reachable from dimensionless spectral data." (theorem-CONFIRMING FAIL branch; the
            PASS branch is the negation, pre-registered symmetrically.)

    Definition 1: tau            = Jensen deformation parameter, DIMENSIONLESS
                                   [get_constant("tau_fold")=0.19, CONST-FREEZE-42].
                                   => taudot = dtau/dt_sub carries units 1/[t_sub].
    Definition 2: D_K eigenvalues = dimensionless (or in M_KK units); the spectrum cache
                                   s84_spectrum_cache_L12_tau019.npz stores |lambda| in M_KK units.
    Definition 3: Z_norm = G_DeWitt = 5.0  [get_constant("G_DeWitt"), S42, s42_gradient_stiffness.npz],
                                   the taudot^2 coefficient in H_sub^2 = Z_norm*taudot^2 + (S_SA - V0)*prefactor;
                                   [Z_norm] = [H_sub^2]/[taudot^2] = (1/[t_sub]^2)/(1/[t_sub]^2) = 1 (DIMENSIONLESS).
    Definition 4: gamma_unit = dt_SI/dt_sub, units [s/t_sub] -- the substrate->seconds conversion
                                   H_SI = H_sub/gamma_unit actually needs (km/s/Mpc).
    Definition 5: kappa_nat = hbar / (M_KK_GeV * GeV_to_J) = 8.860439881925477e-42 s
                                   [S96-W1-MKK-SECONDS]; the "s" comes from hbar (J*s, SI input)
                                   divided by an energy (M_KK in GeV, external calibration).
    Definition 6: f2 ~ 92 = M_Pl/M_KK  [§8.3 dictionary] -- a RATIO of two input ENERGIES,
                                   hence DIMENSIONLESS.

    Substitute (no simplification): H_SI = sqrt(Z_norm*taudot^2 + (S_SA - V0)*prefactor) / gamma_unit.
      The substrate-internal H_sub^2 = Z_norm*taudot^2 + (S_SA-V0)*prefactor has free-variable set
      {S_SA, V0, Z_norm, prefactor, taudot} (Sage, workshop V1 + phonon-first Re:V1, both independently).
      gamma_unit is NOT in that set: free_variables(H_sub^2) does NOT contain gamma_unit
      (Sage: gamma_unit in fv -> False); while dH_SI/dgamma_unit = -sqrt(...)/gamma_unit^2 != 0
      (Sage: bool(diff(H_SI,gamma_unit)!=0) -> True). The seconds-conversion is a slot the
      substrate-internal H_sub^2 does not contain.

    Simplify (dimensional read-off, one step):
      codomain(H_SI) = km/s/Mpc = 1/[time].
      To produce 1/[time] you need a factor carrying [time] (or 1/[time]). The available factors are:
        - D_K eigenvalues:   dimensionless (Def 2)            -> no [time]
        - Z_norm = G_DeWitt: dimensionless (Def 3)            -> no [time]
        - f2 = M_Pl/M_KK:    dimensionless (Def 6)            -> no [time]
        - f (gauge connection), Lambda = M_KK: the ONLY dimensionful input is M_KK (an ENERGY, GeV).
      The unique path from {energy M_KK} to {time} is gamma_unit ~ hbar/(M_KK c^2) (Def 5), which
      imports hbar (SI) and M_KK-in-GeV (external calibration). No combination of dimensionless
      factors reaches 1/[time].

    Canonical form: H_SI = (dimensionless spectral functional of {lambda, f, Z_norm, f2})
                           * (1 / gamma_unit),   gamma_unit = hbar/(M_KK c^2)  [IMPORTED].
    Direction: codomain seconds is UNREACHABLE from the dimensionless domain; the only bridge
               carries an imported dimensionful scale. => imported_scale_count >= 1 for ANY
               H_assembled in km/s/Mpc. => the zero-new-parameter clause FAILS.
    Conclusion (FAIL branch, theorem CONFIRMED): an honest H(tau_now) from D_K+f+Lambda alone imports
```

## §W1-3. S102-NNU-FALSIFIER-II-RANK1-COVARIANCE (CF-β)

```yaml
# ---- Identity (6 fields) ----
gate_id: "S102-NNU-FALSIFIER-II-RANK1-COVARIANCE"
schema_version: "R3"
trigger: "[SIGN]"                  # the sign-resolved correlation pattern sign(p_i*p_j) is the load-bearing directional claim

agent_type: "gen-physicist"        # the covariance-rank theorem is a cross-domain linear-algebra + dimensional-power-counting result (the W7-7a / w5-d3 rank-1-vs-rank-2 lineage); gen-physicist owns the cross-cutting covariance machinery (NOT a Stage-2 verify, so no Stage-0-author exclusion applies)
hypothesis: "Under a single-H renormalization, the borrowed-H shift-covariance across ALL dagger-rows {gamma_unit, 1/G_induced, absolute V0, matter-sector rows} has rank EXACTLY 1, with |Corr|=1 on every pair AND the sign of each pair = sign(p_i*p_j) of the M_KK powers (p = -1 for gamma_unit, +2 for 1/G_induced, +4 for absolute V0, ...); any pair with |Corr|<1 reveals a SECOND independent unprotected scale (rank>=2), falsifying Half B's single-cutoff count and reopening the R2 partial-structure branch."

method:
  description: >
    Build the dagger-row observable set {gamma_unit ~ M_KK^-1, 1/G_induced ~ f2*M_KK^2*a2 ~ M_KK^+2,
    absolute V0 ~ M_KK^+4 via a0/F_-1, matter-sector rows} and their M_KK power vector
    p = (-1, +2, +4, ...). Apply a single-H renormalization shift (perturb the ONE borrowed
    normalization w=M_KK) and compute each row's response. The shift-covariance matrix
    Cov_ij = s_i*s_j*Var(delta_lnw) has entries Corr_ij = sign(s_i*s_j) where s_i = p_i (the
    power); rank(Cov) = rank of the outer product (p * Var * p^T) = 1 for a single scale.
    Compute rank(Cov) numerically (SVD: count singular values > 1e-12*sigma_max) AND |Corr_ij|
    for every pair AND sign(Corr_ij) vs sign(p_i*p_j). The SUBSTRATE-NATURAL DISJOINT ANCHOR is
    the dagger-row DATA itself (the per-channel M_KK powers derived from the a_n moments), NOT the
    registry's published rank (Stage-2 Axis-B disjoint-anchor discipline). Cross-check against the
    W7-7a / S96-HYG-JOINT-EVIDENCE-D3-COVARIANCE anchor Corr(a0,a2)=+1 (p_a0=0 effectively, but the
    a0/a2 pair in the published W7-7a is the rank-1 seed; the dagger-row extension generalizes it to
    the full power vector). PASS iff rank==1 AND |Corr|=1 on every pair AND sign matches; FAIL iff
    any pair |Corr|<1.
  producing_script: "computations/_shared/s102_nnu_falsifier_ii_rank1_covariance.py"

# ---- PRDR Checklist (8 items) ----

# (1) operator
operator:
  type: "set"        # rank-equality AND per-pair |Corr|-equality AND per-pair sign-match (a conjunction)
  form: "rank(Cov) == 1  AND  for all pairs (i,j): |Corr_ij| == 1 (within 1e-9)  AND  sign(Corr_ij) == sign(p_i * p_j)"

# (2) strict_PASS_boundary
strict_PASS_boundary:
  value: "rank(Cov)=1 (SVD: exactly one singular value > 1e-12*sigma_max)  AND  max_pair |1 - |Corr_ij|| <= 1e-9  AND  sign(Corr_ij) == sign(p_i*p_j) for all pairs (zero sign violations)"
  direction: "="

# (3) boundary_reachable_analytically
boundary_reachable_analytically:
  bool: true
  proof_ref: "Analytic: a single scale w projecting at powers p_i gives Cov = Var(delta_lnw) * (p p^T), a rank-1 outer product; Corr_ij = (p_i p_j Var)/sqrt(p_i^2 Var * p_j^2 Var) = sign(p_i p_j) EXACTLY. (w5-d3-rank1-vs-rank2-covariance.md structural derivation; the workshop Half A Sage proof.) The boundary rank=1 / |Corr|=1 is analytically the rank-1 outer-product signature."

# (4) reachable_rationals
reachable_rationals:
  includes_integer_mesh: true       # the power vector p = (-1,+2,+4,...) is an INTEGER mesh; the M_KK powers are integers by the a_n grading
  mesh_density: "integer power vector p_i in {-1,+2,+4,...}; the Corr entries are exactly +-1 (rational)"

# (5) machinery_pin_map
machinery_pin_map:
  N_eval: "binomial(N_rows, 2) pairwise correlations + 1 SVD rank computation; N_rows = number of dagger-rows (>=5: gamma_unit, 1/G_induced, absolute V0, + matter-sector rows)"
  L_max: "12"        # dagger-row observables sourced from the s84 a_n moments at L_max=12
  scan_range: "N/A — single shift-covariance evaluation (no scan); the 'shift' is the single-H renormalization perturbation, analytically a rank-1 outer product"
  step_size: "N/A"
  tolerance: "1e-9 RATIO on |1 - |Corr_ij||; 1e-12*sigma_max SVD rank threshold; exact (zero-violation) on sign"
  scheme: "single-H-renormalization-shift-covariance"
  convention: "RANK1-OUTER-PRODUCT-SIGN-RESOLVED"
  random_seed: "N/A — deterministic (the covariance is the analytic outer product p p^T; no Monte-Carlo)"
  GPU_path: "numpy.linalg (Cov is N_rows x N_rows with N_rows ~ 5-8, <100x100 -> cpu-cap-OMP8: os.environ.setdefault('OMP_NUM_THREADS','8') BEFORE import numpy; SVD on the small matrix)"
  regulator_pin: "a_2^{Mellin}, a_0^{Mellin}, a_4^{Mellin}  # the dagger-row powers derive from the a_n Seeley-DeWitt moments: 1/G_induced ~ f2*M_KK^2*a_2 (p=+2); absolute V0 ~ M_KK^4*a_0/F_-1 (p=+4); gamma_unit ~ M_KK^-1 (p=-1). a_n citations carry the Mellin regulator pin per regulator-pin-discipline.md. (poleconv-A-double; a_2 at s=3 / n=2; a_4 at s=2 / n=4; a_0 at s=4 / n=0.)"
  power_vector_p: "[-1, +2, +4, ...]  # gamma_unit=M_KK^-1, 1/G_induced=M_KK^+2, absolute_V0=M_KK^+4, matter-sector per-row; the substrate-natural disjoint anchor"

# (6) audit_discriminators
audit_discriminators:
  audit_sha256_inputs: ["script", "s84_cache_sha", "dagger_row_power_vector", "W7-7a_corr_anchor", "pinmap"]
  content_sha256_inputs: ["script"]

# (7) substitution_chain — MANDATORY (the sign(p_i*p_j) directional claim)
substitution_chain:
  required: true
  content: |
    Claim: "Under a single-H renormalization, every dagger-row pair has Corr_ij = sign(p_i * p_j)
            of their M_KK powers (NOT blanket +1); rank(Cov) = 1." [SIGN] directional claim.

    Definition 1: w = M_KK = the ONE borrowed dimensional scale (the cutoff; Half B: N_3=0 imports
                            exactly one unprotected scale).
    Definition 2: O_i = w^{p_i} * Ohat_i = the i-th dagger-row observable, with Ohat_i the
                            L_max-INDEPENDENT dimensionless kernel and p_i the integer M_KK power:
                              p(gamma_unit)     = -1   [gamma_unit ~ hbar/(M_KK c^2) ~ M_KK^-1]
                              p(1/G_induced)    = +2   [1/G_induced ~ f2 * M_KK^2 * a_2^{Mellin}]
                              p(absolute V0)    = +4   [absolute V0 ~ M_KK^4 * a_0^{Mellin}/F_-1]
                              p(matter-sector)  = per-row (the m_H/M_0 inheritance powers)
    Definition 3: a single-H renormalization is a shift delta_lnw of ln w. The row response is
                            delta_ln O_i = p_i * delta_lnw  (since ln O_i = p_i ln w + ln Ohat_i and
                            Ohat_i is w-independent: d ln Ohat_i / d ln w = 0).

    Substitute (no simplification): the shift-covariance between rows i and j is
            Cov_ij = E[delta_ln O_i * delta_ln O_j] = E[(p_i delta_lnw)(p_j delta_lnw)]
                   = p_i p_j * E[delta_lnw^2] = p_i p_j * Var(delta_lnw).

    Simplify (one step per line):
            Var_ii = Cov_ii = p_i^2 * Var(delta_lnw)
            Corr_ij = Cov_ij / sqrt(Cov_ii * Cov_jj)
                    = [p_i p_j Var] / sqrt[(p_i^2 Var)(p_j^2 Var)]
                    = [p_i p_j Var] / [|p_i| |p_j| Var]
                    = (p_i p_j) / (|p_i| |p_j|)
                    = sign(p_i p_j).
            Cov = Var(delta_lnw) * (p p^T)  -> outer product of ONE vector p -> rank(Cov) = 1.

    Canonical form: Corr_ij = sign(p_i * p_j) ;  rank(Cov) = 1.
    Direction (read off ONLY now):
            - pairs with same-sign powers (e.g. 1/G_induced p=+2 and absolute V0 p=+4):
              sign(p_i p_j) = sign(+8) = +1.
            - pairs with opposite-sign powers (e.g. gamma_unit p=-1 and 1/G_induced p=+2):
              sign(p_i p_j) = sign(-2) = -1.
            So |Corr|=1 on EVERY pair, with sign SET by the power-product sign -- NOT blanket +1.
    Conclusion: rank-1 covariance with sign-resolved |Corr|=1 is the signature of a SINGLE
            unprotected scale. A genuine SECOND independent scale w2 would add a second outer
            product Var2*(p2 p2^T) with p2 not parallel to p -> rank(Cov) = 2 -> some pair
            |Corr_ij| < 1 (decorrelation possible). Hence the falsifier: any pair |Corr|<1 (NOT
            merely Corr != +1; the sign is predicted) => rank>=2 => Half B falsified, R2 reopens.

# (8) input_files
input_files:

    path: "computations/_shared/canonical_constants.py"
    sha256: "9f2fe9983ecbbb76a2ba1b3e951cf9275deda8d7f2241576ef23b7f728ba1047"

dual_prior:

  track_B: "rank>=2 (Half-B FALSIFIED, a second unprotected scale, most likely m_H/EW-VEV entering the induced action independently of M_KK -- Open Question 6): some pair |Corr|<1. Prior 0.20 (the most physically distinct second-scale candidate; honest pre-registration weight)."
```

```yaml
    Stage-2 two-agent parallel cross-axis independent-verify per joint-theorem-promotion.md §"Stage 2".
    TWO reviewers dispatched IN PARALLEL, one per axis, BOTH operating WITHOUT prior workshop context
    (they receive ONLY the registered Stage-1 entry text + the cited input files; NOT the workshop
    transcript). Axis A (spectral / NCG-axiomatic): audits clause (b) [N_3=0 -> BDI single-cutoff,
    via the spectral-action axis] + clause (d) [dimensional unreachability through the spectral action,
    1/G_induced ~ f2*Lambda^2*a_2] + the JOINT clauses (a)/(c)/(e). Axis B (transit-dynamics /
    cosmological-bridge): audits clause (f) [odd-floor rider, a pole not a scale] + clause (g)
    [moment-decoupling caveat, F_-1 vs F_+1] + the JOINT clauses (a)/(c)/(e). JOINT clauses (a)/(c)/(e)
    are PASS-AND'd: each must independently PASS in BOTH reviewer verdicts. The gate logic combines
    the two verdict files; PASS iff both reviewers PASS all their clauses AND every JOINT clause PASSes
    in both. SUBSTRATE-INPUT-ORTHOGONALITY: clause (a) anchors on the Sage log-Jacobian (covariance
    proof); clause (b) anchors on the S44 N_3=0 invariant -- ORTHOGONAL data (one reviewer loads the
    covariance derivation, the other loads the S44 BDI invariant), satisfying the substrate-input-
    orthogonality predicate (joint-theorem-promotion.md §"Substrate-input-orthogonality clause") at
    the STRUCTURAL CEILING (no overlap caveat needed).
  producing_script: "computations/_shared/s102_nnu_stage2_verify.py"

# ---- PRDR Checklist (8 items) ----

# (1) operator — PASS-AND over two reviewer verdicts (NON-numerical adjudication)
operator:
  type: "set"
  form: "PASS iff (reviewer_A PASSes {clause (b), clause (d)})  AND  (reviewer_B PASSes {clause (f), clause (g)})  AND  (clause (a) PASS in BOTH)  AND  (clause (c) PASS in BOTH)  AND  (clause (e) PASS in BOTH)  [logical AND across all, NOT OR]"

  axis_B_reviewer: "transit-dynamics-theorist  (PRIMARY; transit-dynamics/cosmological-bridge axis; audits clauses (f),(g) + JOINT (a)/(c)/(e))"
  axis_B_fallback: "mack-cosmic-bridge  (PINNED FALLBACK; cosmological-bridge axis, distinct lineage; fires iff transit is flagged Stage-0-author/inheritor)"
  EXCLUSIONS: "volovik-superfluid-universe-theorist AND phonon-first-cosmologist are Stage-0 AUTHORS -> categorically EXCLUDED from BOTH axes (joint-theorem-promotion.md §'Stage-2 Axis-B Selection Protocol' condition 2: original-authoring-agent exclusion with downstream-inheritance reach). The S101 A12 precedent (volovik->landau pinned-fallback substitution) shows the exclusion audit firing as designed; the pinned fallbacks above are the analog for THIS theorem."
  exclusion_audit: "_joint_theorem_independent_verify_audit.py --check-reviewers --strict  RUN AT PLAN-FREEZE: confirms (i) axis-distinctness (A=spectral, B=transit/cosmo -- different axes); (ii) neither reviewer is volovik/phonon-first nor a downstream-inheritor (memory/feedback-file grep for workshop-transcript re-citation); (iii) audit-coverage adequacy (A covers all spectral clauses + JOINT; B covers all transit clauses + JOINT). On any flag -> the pinned fallback fires."

# ---- Verdict rubric ----
PASS_meaning: "Both reviewers independently PASS all their single-axis clauses AND every JOINT clause (a)/(c)/(e) PASSes in BOTH verdicts. The theorem-tag has STRUCTURALLY-INDEPENDENT cross-axis confirmation (the two reviewers never saw the workshop; their agreement is NOT shared-context agreement per epistemic-discipline.md §'What Does NOT Count as Evidence' item 2). With item-2 FAIL + item-3 sustained |Corr|=1, the session-end orchestrator flips STAGE-1-CANDIDATE -> STAGE-3-PERMANENT (Stage-3-CLASS JOINT-CROSS-AXIS-STAGE-2-PASS-AND, substrate-input-orthogonality SATISFIED)."
FAIL_meaning: "Either reviewer FAILs any clause, OR a JOINT clause FAILs in either verdict. Stage-2 -> Stage-3 promotion BLOCKED; the theorem stays at STAGE-1-CANDIDATE; the FAILing clause(s) route to S103 remediation. (Closes the 'cross-axis-confirmed' corridor for this round; the candidate remains citable with the STAGE-1-CANDIDATE qualifier.)"
INFO_meaning: "Either reviewer returns INFO on a clause (a clause that is neither clean-PASS nor clean-FAIL -- e.g. a clause whose verification is genuinely ambiguous at this L_max). The theorem stays at Stage-1; the INFO clause is documented as a Stage-2-INFO-deferred item per joint-theorem-promotion.md Stage-2 INFO criterion. NOT a promotion."

# ---- Effort + framing ----
effort:
  files_created:

    - "computations/session-102/s102_nnu_stage2_verify.npz"
  estimated_time: "1 dual-dispatch gate (~3-4 hours: two parallel reviewer dispatches + the PASS-AND combine + exclusion-audit confirmation)"

substrate_framing: |
  GEOMETRIC. The gate verifies a structural claim about the FABRIC's normalization structure
  (the conformal-class-complete-but-dimensionally-non-universal theorem). Both reviewers re-derive
  the substrate-IS content from first principles -- the rank-1 covariance (D_K -> a_n moments -> the
  M_KK^p p^T outer product), the N_3=0 BDI topological cause (S44), the dimensional unreachability
  through the spectral action (1/G_induced ~ f2*Lambda^2*a_2). The cross-axis independence (spectral
  vs transit/cosmological) is the structural guarantee that the agreement is real, not shared-context
  echo. The arrow is preserved by construction: the reviewers verify that the substrate determines
  the dimensionless dynamical content and imports exactly one external scale M_KK -- they do NOT
  re-explain the result via GR.
```

## Wave 1 → Wave 2 Decision Point

Wave 2 (`gen-physicist`, Stage-2 verifies + registry/capstone reconciliation) does NOT consume any Wave-1 numerical output directly; it runs the §VII.BP / §VII.BQ Stage-2 verifies and the §VII.AM / s=7 LC reconciliations. But the session-end **Stage-3-PERMANENT promotion** of the Normalization-Non-Universality theorem-tag is decided on the Wave-1 verdict pattern:

| Wave-1 verdict pattern | Stage-3 action (session-end, orchestrator-direct) |
|:-----------------------|:--------------------------------------------------|
| item 1 PASS ∧ item 4 PASS-AND ∧ item 2 FAIL ∧ item 3 PASS (`|Corr|=1`) | **STAGE-1-CANDIDATE → STAGE-3-PERMANENT** (Stage-3-CLASS `JOINT-CROSS-AXIS-STAGE-2-PASS-AND`, substrate-input-orthogonality SATISFIED). The two falsifiers fired their theorem-CONFIRMING branches (item-2 FAIL = rank-1 source confirmed; item-3 `|Corr|=1` = rank-1 count confirmed) AND the cross-axis verify passed. The theorem is permanent. |
| item 1 PASS ∧ item 4 PASS-AND ∧ item 2 PASS (theorem FALSIFIED) | **RETRACT the Stage-1 entry** — item-2 PASS means `gamma_unit` IS writable from spectral data alone (rank-0); the theorem-tag is wrong. Stage-2 PASS is moot; the entry is retracted to atlas-09 with the falsification recorded. Capstone §6.3 patch (item 5) reverts to "a(t) recoverable" (the original gap framing was correct). |
| item 1 PASS ∧ item 4 PASS-AND ∧ item 3 FAIL (`|Corr|<1`) | **Half B retracts to rank-N** — a second independent unprotected scale exists (rank ≥ 2; candidate m_H/EW-VEV, Open Question 6). The theorem-tag's rank-1 claim is wrong; the memo's R2 partial-structure branch REOPENS.
